root: Uni-CLI 0.400.1 adds a domain-neutral federated retrieval kernel with 41 registered read-only evidence sources, normalized provenance, exact recovery actions, and structured partial failures.

The AI overlay exposes search, pulse, read, sources, landscape, and profiles across 35 executable sources, 102 maintained primary targets, and 10 practitioner roles covering models, systems, hardware, world models, embodied AI, agents, safety, and research.

EvidenceDocument v1 provides canonical URLs, structured headings and links, true truncation metadata, retrieval timestamps, and returned-content hashes for HTML, text, structured data, PDF text, and GitHub threads.

Bounded concurrency, strict freshness semantics, explicit authentication, redirect/cache validation, binary and challenge rejection, and end-to-end cancellation keep live retrieval honest without coupling domain logic to transports.
zh: Uni-CLI 0.400.1 新增领域无关的联邦检索内核：统一发现 41 个只读证据源，保留规范化来源、精确恢复动作与结构化局部失败。
AI overlay 提供 search、pulse、read、sources、landscape、profiles，覆盖 35 个可执行来源、102 个维护的一手目标与 10 类从业者角色，包括模型、系统、硬件、世界模型、具身智能、Agent、安全和研究。
EvidenceDocument v1 为 HTML、文本、结构化数据、PDF 文本与 GitHub thread 统一提供 canonical URL、标题层级、链接、真实截断信息、获取时间和返回内容哈希。
有界并发、严格时效语义、显式认证、redirect/cache 校验、二进制与 challenge 拒绝以及端到端取消，使实时检索保持真实，同时避免领域逻辑与 transport 耦合。
